svg.aria-label: Poison messages and dead-letter queues: a consumer retries a failing message a few times with backoff, then moves it to a dead-letter queue so the rest of the queue keeps flowing; an alert fires and an engineer inspects and replays it after a fix.
svg.title: Poison messages and dead-letter queues: a consumer retries a failing message a few times with backoff, then moves it to a dead-letter queue so the rest of the queue keeps flowing; an alert fires and an engineer inspects and replays it after a fix.
svg.text: alert on DLQ depth → inspect → fix → replay
